summary: Backend end-to-end testing of Medinest completed. 42/42 pytest cases passed including full happy path (register → triage → case → mock payment → doctor accept → chat → notes → prescription → complete → care plan → feedback → rating update). AI triage (GPT-5.2), AI care-plan generation, AI health-tips, JWT auth (cookie + Bearer fallback), bcrypt hashing, RBAC, admin approval/suspension, vitals CRUD, payments (mocked Paystack) all functional. Doctor earnings (70% share) correctly credited on consultation completion.

critical.issue: Doctors with status='pending' (not yet approved by admin) can log in and access ALL doctor-only routes — they can view the case queue, accept cases, send messages, issue prescriptions, and complete consultations. require_role('doctor') only checks role, not status. Verified by logging in as doctor.pending@medinest.africa and successfully hitting GET /api/cases/queue (200). Pending/rejected doctors should be blocked from all clinical routes.

minor.issue: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False. Comment claims 'Cookies still work cross-origin via samesite=lax' — that is incorrect. With samesite=lax, cookies are NOT sent on cross-origin XHR/fetch from a different domain (frontend domain ≠ backend domain through ingress is same-origin via /api proxy, so it works here, but the comment is misleading). Bearer-token auth works fine.

Brute-force lockout resets locked_at timestamp on every failed attempt while count is below 5, then once >=5 it sticks. Behavior is acceptable but the 15-min window is effectively a rolling window. Working as designed; verify whether desired.
Hardcoded JWT secret is committed in .env. Acceptable for dev/preview but should be rotated/secret-managed for production.
Reset link is only printed to server logs (no email sender configured). Acceptable for MVP; flag for production.

action_items: Block pending/rejected doctors from doctor-only clinical routes — extend require_role('doctor') to also assert user['status']=='approved', or add a separate require_approved_doctor dependency used by /cases/queue, /cases/assigned, /consultations/accept, /consultations/{id}/notes, /consultations/{id}/prescription, /consultations/{id}/complete.
Fix misleading CORS comment in server.py; if real cross-origin cookie auth is desired, set allow_credentials=True with explicit origin list (FRONTEND_URL).
Consider wiring forgot-password to an actual email provider for production.
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC depth: require_role only checks role, missing status check — pending doctors get full clinical access (see critical issue).

ai_service._chat_json strips backticks but JSON parsing has no retry on malformed output; the broad try/except in run_triage/generate_care_plan/generate_health_tips provides safe fallback so this is acceptable.
feedback.py recomputes doctor rating average using stored avg*count formula — accurate but floating-point. Acceptable.
consultations.complete_consultation credits earnings by reading payment with status='success' — correctly handles refund/no-payment edge by skipping credit.
All routes correctly exclude MongoDB _id from responses via projection {'_id': 0}.
Pydantic models use min_length=6 for password — weak policy but matches MVP scope.
test_credentials: All seeded credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md are valid and working: admin@medinest.africa/Admin@123, doctor@medinest.africa/Doctor@123, doctor.pending@medinest.africa/Doctor@123, patient@medinest.africa/Patient@123
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed users via /api/auth/register during testing (test_pat_*, test_doc_*, test_pend_*). Not cleaned up — admin can view via /api/admin/users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend e2e suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression baseline (42 tests, ~40s runtime, includes 2 GPT-5.2 calls + 1 care-plan AI call). The only outstanding backend bug is the RBAC gap allowing pending doctors clinical access — re-run TestRBAC after main agent fix and add a specific test that logs in as doctor.pending and confirms /api/cases/queue returns 403.
rca_of_the_issue: RBAC gap RCA: auth_utils.require_role(*roles) only validates user['role'] in roles; it never checks user['status']. The login endpoint blocks 'suspended' users (correct) but allows 'pending' and 'rejected' doctors to obtain a valid JWT. Once authenticated, every doctor-only route accepts them. Mitigation: add status check inside require_role for role=='doctor' (require status=='approved'), or introduce a dedicated dependency require_approved_doctor and apply on clinical routes.
